escalations.name: SLA Warning at 75% Dwell Limit
escalations.triggerCondition: 75% of stage turnaround SLA elapsed without forward transition
escalations.description: Triggers amber visual warning on Control Tower and dispatches automated reminder.

escalations.name: SLA Breach at 100% (Tier 1 Escalation)
escalations.description: Red flag raised, immediate notification sent to departmental directorate.

escalations.name: Critical Overdue (>48h past SLA)
escalations.triggerCondition: Bill unresolved 48 hours after SLA breach
escalations.description: Direct escalation to Executive Management and inclusion in urgent morning intervention list.

escalations.name: Audit Objection & Rejection Loop
escalations.triggerCondition: Bill returned/rejected by pre-audit or accounts due to document discrepancy
escalations.description: Routes docket to Return Queue with mandatory itemized objection notice.

escalations.name: Mandatory Document Missing Gate
escalations.triggerCondition: Stage completion attempted without all mandatory documents uploaded
escalations.description: Hard-stops forward stage transition until mandatory checklists and documents are satisfied.

escalations.name: Transit 20% Retention Escrow Gate
escalations.description: Automatically instantiates the parallel 20% statutory HR retention docket.
